hook: Reis-Filho built his career deciphering cancer genomics at the bench, at the Institute of Cancer Research and then as Chief of Experimental Pathology at Memorial Sloan Kettering, before moving to AstraZeneca to apply AI foundation models and agentic frameworks directly to drug discovery and clinical development, one of the clearer examples of a working oncologist becoming an enterprise AI leader.
name: Jorge Reis-Filho

quote.text: Our focus includes developing advanced foundation models and agentic frameworks, strategically crucial technologies aligned with AstraZeneca's bold ambition.
quote.context: Jorge Reis-Filho, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: Chief of AI for Science Innovation at AstraZeneca

timeline.event: Becomes Team Leader, Molecular Pathology, Institute of Cancer Research
timeline.impact: Begins academic leadership in cancer genomics research

timeline.event: Wins the CRUK Future Leaders Prize and USCAP Ramzi Cotran Award
timeline.impact: Early-career research recognized at national level

timeline.event: Joins Memorial Sloan Kettering as Chief of Experimental Pathology
timeline.impact: Leads translational cancer research at a leading U.S. cancer center

timeline.event: Joins AstraZeneca as VP, Cancer Biomarker Development
timeline.impact: Moves biomarker research into pharmaceutical R&D

timeline.event: Named Chief of AI for Science Innovation, AstraZeneca
timeline.impact: Leads AI foundation model deployment for drug discovery

quick_facts: Chief of AI for Science Innovation, Enterprise AI Unit at AstraZeneca, leading foundation models and agentic frameworks for drug discovery
Former Chief of Experimental Pathology at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center
Won the CRUK Future Leaders Prize (2010) and the BCRF Larry Norton Award (2023)
Former Professor and Chair of Molecular Pathology at The Institute of Cancer Research, London

achievements.title: Chief of AI for Science Innovation, AstraZeneca (2025-present)
achievements.impact: Leads deployment of foundation models and agentic AI frameworks across AstraZeneca's drug discovery and clinical development pipeline.

achievements.title: Chief, Experimental Pathology, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (2016-2023)
achievements.impact: Directed a nearly eight-year research program integrating genomic technologies, big data analytics, and AI, bridging academic research and commercial biotech partnerships.

achievements.title: Vice President, Cancer Biomarker Development, AstraZeneca
achievements.impact: Led the creation and clinical validation of biomarkers used to select optimal cancer treatments and therapeutic combinations for individual patients.

achievements.title: Professor and Chair of Molecular Pathology, The Institute of Cancer Research
achievements.impact: Led a molecular pathology research program studying intra-tumor genetic heterogeneity and DNA repair deficiencies in cancer.

achievements.title: Scientific advisory roles at Paige.AI, Repare Therapeutics, and Volition
achievements.impact: Advised on AI-driven computational pathology diagnostics, including work supporting the FDA clearance of Paige Prostate.
